      "snippet": "Sandcrawler Sweep #6 — Domain: Astrophysics (Extreme Variety Mode)

(1) Name of the discovery
The Roche Limit Catastrophe Threshold

(2) Deep Explanation (what it is)
The Roche Limit is the distance from a massive body (like a planet or star) at which a smaller celestial object (like a moon, asteroid, or spacecraft) is torn apart by tidal forces that exceed the object’s own gravity or internal cohesion.
It is NOT a gradual effect.
It is a catastrophic boundary.
Outside the limit → stable orbit.
